headline: AMD unveils Helion rack design for agentic AI servers at OCP summit
summary: AMD revealed Helion, a rack-scale reference design for agentic AI servers that can house up to 32,768 Zen 6 CPU cores, at the OCP Global Summit. CPU-only and mixed CPU/GPU configurations are due from partners in November.
